steps.content: Nearly a hundred gangsters emerge from the streets, trying to break through the hospital's defenses. Ted is nowhere to be found in the crowd.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...Are they here to save you, Chief?
A grenade explodes above your head. Iron blocks the rubble for you with her prosthesis.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=32>It's this bunch of bastards again... They really know nothing apart from fighting and killing... What a waste of time. Let's just chop their brains off, they don't use them anyway...</size></color>

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Oh, no! Our medical director hates these idiot gangsters the most! She's gonna get angry!

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: The Maniacs and that kid can't take any more of this. Let me send them to the basement for refuge. Please send any new patients down as well.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: I'll leave it to you here. Protect everyone and yourself.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Besides, we have the Chief of Minos with us. It'll be more than enough to handle them.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: SALVA had enough power to fight, but you wiped them out. Shouldn't you make up for it, Chief?

steps.speaker: Options
options: ...Looks like refusing isn't an option for me.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Heh. Don't worry. I'll pay back the favor I owe you.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...I'd never expect you to take our side. They may be your companions here to save you.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Have you? Then I look forward to seeing what you can do.
